article.title: CatCoin Migration: The Next Chapter of CATCOIN.COM
article.preview_text: After extensive internal discussion with the CatCoin community, core holders, and long-term supporters, we have decided to migrate CatCoin to a new smart contract and move the project from BNB Chain

blocks.text: After extensive internal discussion with the CatCoin community, core holders, and long-term supporters, we have decided to migrate CatCoin to a new smart contract and move the project from BNB Chain to Solana.
This isn't simply a new token launch. It is a migration of the existing CatCoin ecosystem, holders, liquidity, and community into a cleaner and more unified structure.
Here is everything holders need to know 👇
Why Are We Changing the Smart Contract?
CatCoin's existing contracts were created years ago. As the project and market have evolved, several structural issues have become increasingly difficult to solve under the existing setup.
1. Ticker confusion 🐱
Our existing ticker is $CAT, while some exchanges and platforms display the token as CATCOIN.
At the same time, many unrelated projects use the generic $CAT ticker.
As part of the migration:

Old ticker: $CAT
New ticker: $CATCOIN
This gives CatCoin a much clearer and more recognizable identity.
2. Copycats are creating confusion🐱
Over the years, multiple unrelated tokens have appeared using the CatCoin, CAT and similar identities.
This has created unnecessary confusion for users trying to identify the original CatCoin ecosystem.
Moving to CatCoin / $CATCOIN, together with a coordinated contract migration, gives the community a much clearer official identity.
3. $CAT chart and real-time price aren't properly represented on X🐱
The generic $CAT ticker is shared by numerous projects.
As a result, when users interact with $CAT on X, CatCoin's chart and real-time price are not consistently represented as our official market.

Moving to the more distinctive $CATCOIN ticker should make our identity significantly clearer across social platforms and market-data integrations, although individual platforms ultimately control their own ticker and price-display systems.
4. Extremely large existing supply🐱
The current CatCoin supply contains an unnecessarily large number of tokens and zeros.
This makes supply figures, token pricing and general market communication more complicated than necessary.
The new CatCoin supply will be:
A simple 1 billion token supply.
5. Different supply structures across chains🐱
Our existing BNB Chain and Solana contracts do not have identical supply structures.
Maintaining different supplies, contracts and liquidity markets makes operating a unified CatCoin ecosystem unnecessarily complicated.
6. Fragmented liquidity🐱
Liquidity is currently spread across different chains and markets.
The migration allows us to move toward one primary liquidity market, rather than continuing to divide liquidity across legacy contracts.
7. Exchange, wallet and platform integrations🐱
Multiple contracts, different supplies, fragmented liquidity and a generic ticker make integrations with exchanges, wallets, price trackers and other platforms more difficult.
The migration gives CatCoin a much cleaner structure going forward.
🔄 Migration Ratio
The official migration ratio will be:
50,000,000 OLD $CAT = 1 NEW $CATCOIN
This is a redenomination of the supply, not a reduction in your proportional ownership.
If you own 1% of the eligible old CatCoin supply, you will receive 1% of the new CatCoin supply when you migrate during the standard migration window.
For example:
1% of the new 1 billion supply = 10,000,000 $CATCOIN
Your token count changes.
Your percentage ownership does not.
🌐 How Will Migration Work?
The official migration platform will be  @MigrateFun
🔴🔴Migration Link - https://migrate.fun/migrate/mig221 ↩️
Both BNB Chain and existing Solana CatCoin holders will be able to participate in the migration by connecting their eligible wallets through the official migration interface.
Detailed instructions and the official migration link will be published through CatCoin's official channels before migration begins.
🎟️ IMPORTANT: Keep Your MFT Token
After completing the migration process through Migrate.fun, users will receive an MFT token representing their migration allocation.
DO NOT SELL, SEND, TRANSFER OR BURN YOUR MFT TOKEN.
Keep the MFT token safely in the same wallet.
Once the new $CATCOIN launches on Pump.fun, eligible holders will be able to use their MFT allocation to claim/swap into the new $CATCOIN according to the migration terms.
Your MFT token is therefore an important part of the migration process.
Do not send it to another user.
Do not burn it.
Do not treat it as a normal tradable token.
Keep it securely in your wallet until the official $CATCOIN claim/swap process is announced.
⏳ 19 Days Migration Window
All eligible holders will initially have 19 Days to migrate.
Holders who complete migration during this period will receive:
100% of their eligible $CATCOIN allocation
There is no migration penalty during the initial 19 days window.
We strongly encourage everyone to migrate during this period.
📸 Holder Snapshot
When the initial migration window ends, a snapshot of eligible CatCoin holders on both BNB Chain and Solana will be taken.
The purpose of this snapshot is to protect holders who may have missed the initial migration.
Being included in the snapshot allows an eligible holder to participate as a late claimer during the subsequent claim period.
⏰ 90-Day Late Claim Window
If you miss the initial 19 days migration but are included in the snapshot, you will still have a further:
90 days to claim your $CATCOIN
Late claimers will receive 90% of their eligible allocation.
A 10% late-claim penalty will apply.
So the structure is simple:
Initial 19 days → 100% allocation
90-day late claim → 90% allocation
After 90 days → Claims closed
📣 What Happens to the 10% Late-Claim Penalty?
The 10% deducted from late claims will be allocated toward CatCoin marketing and new-user acquisition initiatives.
The objective is to use these resources to expand CatCoin's reach, attract new users and grow the ecosystem following the migration.
Migrating during the initial 19 days period remains the simplest option: you receive 100% of your eligible allocation.
⌛ What Happens After the 90-Day Claim Period?
After the 90-day late-claim period ends, the migration will be considered closed.
Any unclaimed $CATCOIN allocation will be returned to the CatCoin migration team.
Holders who neither migrated during the initial period nor completed an eligible late claim during the 90-day window will no longer be eligible to claim that allocation.
🏦 What If Your CatCoin Is on an Exchange?
If your old $CAT is held on a centralized exchange that officially confirms support for the CatCoin migration, the exchange will handle the migration process for its users.
You should not manually migrate exchange-held tokens unless your exchange specifically instructs you to do so.
We will publish the list of exchanges supporting the migration as confirmations are received.
If an exchange does not support the migration, holders should follow the exchange's instructions and our official migration guidance before the deadline.
🔒 What Happens to the Old Contracts?
Following migration, the legacy CatCoin contracts on BNB Chain and Solana will become officially unsupported.
Liquidity controlled by the project and designated for migration will be withdrawn/migrated from the legacy markets to support the new $CATCOIN ecosystem.
Users should stop buying or trading through the old contract addresses once the migration is completed.
The new $CATCOIN contract will become the officially supported CatCoin contract going forward.
☀️ Why Are We Moving to Solana?
CatCoin is not starting from zero.
We are moving an established community from BNB Chain to Solana.
CatCoin has built a holder base of 100,000+ wallets on BNB Chain, and this migration creates an opportunity to introduce a significant existing crypto community to the Solana ecosystem.
For many of our holders, this may also be their first experience interacting with Pump.fun. @pumpfun
Instead of simply creating another token and trying to build a community around it, CatCoin is bringing its existing holders, community, liquidity, brand and history into its new ecosystem.
That distinction matters.
We believe introducing existing BNB Chain users to a new ecosystem while simultaneously exposing CatCoin to a new group of active traders creates an opportunity for both communities to grow.
🛡️ Migration Security
Migration periods inevitably attract scammers.
CatCoin will never ask for your seed phrase or private key.
Do not connect your wallet through links received from random DMs, replies, unofficial Telegram groups or impersonator accounts.
Before connecting your wallet, always verify the migration link through CatCoin's official channels and CatCoin.com.
The official migration page, exact dates, legacy contract addresses, new contract address and detailed instructions will be announced before migration begins.
🐱 The Goal
This migration is designed to solve problems that have accumulated over CatCoin's history:
Cleaner 1 billion supply.
$CAT → $CATCOIN.
Reduced copycat and ticker confusion.
Simpler exchange and platform integrations.
Consolidated liquidity.
One officially supported contract.
One unified CatCoin ecosystem.
The goal can ultimately be summarized in one line:
One $CATCOIN. One supply structure. One primary liquidity market. One official contract.
We are not leaving CatCoin's history behind.
We are bringing it with us into the next chapter.
